tables.name: map_shrinkage_factor
tables.units: k (fraction of true deviation from mean retained); sigmas in mm
tables.population: any (exact arithmetic for independent Gaussian prior and Gaussian data term)
tables.notes: k = sp^2/(sp^2+sd^2); 1-k is the anti-caricature bias of a MAP fit. Per coordinate, k = 1 - var_post/var_prior from diag((J^T J)^-1). Typical sd (expert estimates): lateral 0.5-1 mm with 3+ views; depth ~2x lateral with views >=30 deg apart; depth 10-20 mm frontal-only. sigma_prior 8 mm is face3d Priors default.
